title: Cure of a Missed Recovery on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — cure protection at a missed-recovery review.** The shortfall payday is the latest pay date carried by a shortfall on or after the plan's level effective date.

The cure protection measures the cured share, what was collected on the shortfall carrying the shortfall payday over that shortfall, by method:

1. for a plan whose card recovery authorization is true held by a worker with a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account whose status is active, what was collected is the amount of the debits whose debit type is EWA recovery posted to the worker's card accounts in the last month;
2. for a plan without both that authorization and an active card account, with voluntary payment recoveries carrying the shortfall payday, what was collected is their amount;
3. otherwise nothing counts as collected and the cured share is zero.

A cured share of **50 percent** or more lets the plan keep the tier one below its current tier, **25 percent** up to 50 percent the tier two below, and less than 25 percent, a cured share of zero included, leaves only Paystride Access Starter.

A tier named as one or two below the current tier never goes below Paystride Access Starter. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Authorization true and card account active | What counts as collected |
|---|---|
| both | EWA recovery debits posted to the worker's card accounts in the last month |
| not both, with voluntary payments carrying the shortfall payday | those voluntary payments |
| not both, no such voluntary payment | nothing: cured share zero |

| Cured share | Highest tier the plan may keep |
|---|---|
| 50 percent or more | one below its current tier |
| 25 percent up to but not including 50 percent | two below its current tier |
| less than 25 percent | Paystride Access Starter only |

*Hypothetical:* a shortfall of 146.00 USD on a plan with the authorization and an active card, with EWA recovery debits of 73.00 USD posted in the last month: cured share 50 percent, one below. With debits of 36.49 USD: just under 25 percent, Paystride Access Starter only. With no authorization and voluntary payments of 41.30 USD carrying the shortfall payday: about 28.3 percent, two below.
